description: Browse Selah's library of public-domain classics: commentaries, creeds and confessions, Church Fathers, Apocrypha and other ancient writings. With no arguments, lists every work with its author, year and canon-status label. With work_id, returns that work's table of contents. With work_id and path, returns that section's text. Every work is labeled so nothing is mistaken for Scripture.

path.description: A section path from the work's table of contents.

work_id.description: A work id from the list, such as westminster.

name: browse_library
title: Browse library
